paper.title_en: Quasinormal Modes and Excitation Factors of a Parity-Symmetric Beyond-Horndeski Black Hole
paper.abstract_en: We study scalar, electromagnetic, and Dirac perturbations of an asymptotically flat black hole in parity-symmetric beyond-Horndeski gravity. The quasinormal spectrum is computed with very-high-order WKB expansions and Padé resummation, with Cesàro means used to diagnose internal convergence. The dominant modes are independently tested by time-domain evolution with Prony extraction and by Chebyshev pseudospectral collocation; the latter also provides systematic frequency scans in both the metric-scale and physical ADM-mass normalizations. Excitation factors are obtained separately from Green-function residues by complex-contour integration. In the fixed metric-scale normalization, approaching Schwarzschild generally increases both the oscillation frequency and damping rate, whereas stronger deformation shifts the modes toward lower frequencies and weaker damping. In ADM-mass units, the mildly deformed solutions remain close to Schwarzschild, while the most deformed sector becomes enhanced and nonmonotonic because the asymptotic mass itself varies strongly. The independent methods agree very well, however the sixth-order WKB approximation used in [G. Antoniou, T. D. Pappas, P. Kanti, Phys. Rev. D 112, 084013 (2025)] is insufficient in certain regions of the parameter space: the fundamental-mode discrepancy reaches nine percent in the damping rate and the first-overtone discrepancy can be of order unity. The Schwarzschild excitation factors are recovered. In the strongly deformed regime, their magnitudes can differ from the Schwarzschild values by more than two orders of magnitude in the asymptotic tortoise-coordinate convention. We show that this large effect is predominantly due to the deformation-dependent displacement of the potential barrier in the tortoise coordinate: when its maximum is used as the origin, the excitation factors exhibit much more modest deviations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究宇称对称的超越Horndeski引力中黑洞的标量、电磁与Dirac扰动，属于修改引力理论（Horndeski族）范畴；使用高阶WKB、Padé重求和、Cesàro均值、时域演化与Prony提取、Chebyshev伪谱配点以及复围道积分等多种独立方法交叉验证，并指出文献中六阶WKB近似的不足，方法严谨且具有实质新意，值得点入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 宇称对称超越Horndeski黑洞的准正规模与激发因子
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究宇称对称的超越Horndeski引力中一个渐近平坦黑洞的标量、电磁与Dirac扰动。准正规模谱用极高阶WKB展开与Padé重求和计算，并用Cesàro均值诊断内部收敛性。主导模式由时域演化配合Prony提取以及Chebyshev伪谱配点独立检验；后者还在度规标度归一化与物理ADM质量归一化两种情形下提供系统的频率扫描。激发因子则通过复围道积分从格林函数留数中分别获得。在固定度规标度归一化下，趋近Schwarzschild一般会同时提高振荡频率与阻尼率，而更强的变形则使模式向更低频率与更弱阻尼移动。在以ADM质量为单位时，轻度变形的解仍接近Schwarzschild，而变形最强的区域则被增强且呈现非单调行为，因为渐近质量本身变化剧烈。各独立方法符合得很好，然而[G. Antoniou, T. D. Pappas, P. Kanti, Phys. Rev. D 112, 084013 (2025)]中所用的六阶WKB近似在参数空间的某些区域并不充分：基模的阻尼率偏差可达百分之九，第一泛音的偏差可达量级为一。Schwarzschild激发因子被重现。在强变形情形下，在渐近龟坐标约定下其幅度可与Schwarzschild值相差超过两个数量级。我们表明这一巨大效应主要来自势垒在龟坐标中随变形而发生的位移：当以其极大值作为原点时，激发因子的偏差要温和得多。
